newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine soybeans up after Chicago, Brazil talk.
newsitem.headline: Argentine soybeans up after Chicago, Brazil talk.

text.p: Argentine soybeans were higher in tight cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with bids rising after a higher Chicago and talk of a possible Brazilian export tax on beans, traders said.

But the market's recent volatility has led some players to stay on the sidelines, keeping volume low. Prices paid to farmers for May soybeans in Buenos Aires rose $5 to $288. Cash maize also rose, squeezed up by tight supply and export demand. Exporters were paying $2 in Buenos Aires at $111. Cash sunseed was firm on higher soybeans and disappointment over yields. Bahia Blanca wheat lost $2 to $140 in slow trade.
